messages:
dan: Pulled the monthly recurrence export and highlighted clusters by root cause. Dropping link and a brief ask: can owners confirm or reassign actions by EOD Friday so we can ship playbooks next sprint. https://drive.redwood/incidents/recurrence-export-2026
emma: thanks dan. can you include a revenue-weighted impact column? frequency alone underplays a few big customers.
dan: added revenue_weighted column in tab
tyler: quick look: there are three dominant families — infra (network / drains), runtime (batching/backpressure / cold start), and data (kv-cache invalidations & bad config). suggest we attack infra+runtime first (most user-visible).
olivia: agree. for infra items can we build a "sweep" checklist playbook (owner, runbook, rollback steps, post-checks) so SRE oncall can run it without deeper context?
dan: good idea. pasted proposed actions below — react with :thumbsup: to own, :eyes: to support.

```
ActionID,Action,Owner,Support,Due,Status
B201,Network drain detection & auto-quiet,tyler,eng-sre;eng-infra,2026-05-05,proposed
B202,Runtime adaptive warmup + canary gating,dan,eng-runtime;eng-sre,2026-05-12,proposed
B203,Batch backpressure: proxy mitigation + runtime CB,emma,eng-platform;eng-sre,2026-05-20,proposed
B204,KV-cache roll-forward instrumentation + exp backfill,tyler,eng-ml,2026-04-30,proposed
B205,Sweep playbook for infra incidents,olivia,eng-sre;oncall,2026-04-22,proposed
```

emma: I'll take B203 but want to do proxy quickfix first (7 day TTL) then runtime work.
tyler: taking B201 and B204. B204 needs dataset access from eng-ml — pinging @eng-ml channel.
olivia: taking B205. propose a 2-week window for writing and practicing the playbook with oncall squad.
product-bot: Action created: B203 (Batch backpressure)  Tracker: https://tracker.redwood/actions/B203
ops-bot: Reminder: add rollback & canary plans to every Action before marking in-progress.
dan: noted. added canary+rollback checklist to B202 and B203 rows.
emma: small ask  we should sequence B204 instrumentation before runtime CB so we know baseline failure modes. recommend timeline: B204 -> proxy quickfix -> B203 runtime CB.
tyler: agree with sequencing. will coordinate with eng-ml to get data by 2026-04-18.
olivia: once playbook draft ready I'll run a tabletop with oncall next Wed.
product-bot: Meeting scheduled: Incident Pattern Triage  2026-04-09 16:00 UTC (30m)  Attendees: dan, emma, tyler, olivia, eng-sre reps
dan: please update owner column in the sheet with JIRA tickets and tracker links. I'll consolidate into the retro notes.
ops-bot: Owners updated in Tracker for actions: B201,B202,B203,B204,B205  https://tracker.redwood/actions/1846905123
emma: added a short proxy snippet to the doc for the quickfix and a monitoring dashboard alert.
tyler: created JIRA tickets for B201 and B204 and linked tracker.
olivia: scheduled the playbook dry-run with oncall for 2026-04-14. invite sent.
dan: thanks everyone. final ask: owners add a measurable success criterion (error rate reduction, p95 latency lift, customer incidents reduced) to each action by the meeting so we can evaluate impact in the next monthly review.
product-bot: Note: monthly recurrence review cadence confirmed  next deep review: 2026-07-01
dan: Closing thread; we will track progress via tracker and the meeting notes. ping me if you need re-prioritization.
